features: [Powerful Output]: With a powerful 20W output, the ZEB-Vita Bar 150 delivers robust, immersive sound that can fill any room, making it ideal for parties, gatherings, or personal use.

[Dual Passive Radiators]: The ZEB-Vita Bar 150's dual passive radiators enhance bass performance, delivering deeper, richer low-frequency sounds and creating a balanced, full-bodied audio output in conjunction with the dual drivers.

[Multi-connectivity]: The ZEB-Vita Bar 150 features multiple connectivity options with BT v5.3, this mini-soundbar provides a stable wireless connection while the mSD, USB and AUX inputs offer flexible connections to various audio sources
[Dual Drivers]: The ZEB-Vita Bar 150's powerful dual 5.2cm drivers deliver clear, dynamic sound across a wide frequency range, ensuring precise and immersive audio for every note, beat, and vocal.

[Longer playtime]: The ZEB-Vita Bar 150 features a built-in rechargeable battery with up to 8* hours(* at 50% volume(LED off)) of playback and convenient type-C charging, ensuring your music plays throughout the day.
[RGB LED lights]: The ZEB-Vita Bar 150's RGB LED lights enhance your listening experience with vibrant visual effects, adding a dynamic element to your audio.
[Controls]: The ZEB-Vita Bar 150 offers intuitive media and volume controls, allowing for easy adjustment of audio settings without needing to interact with your connected device directly.
[TWS function]: To double up your entertainment, the ZEB-Vita Bar 150 mini-soundbar is equipped with a TWS function that allows you to connect two ZEB-Vita Bar 150 simultaneously.
[Splash-proof]: Its splash-proof feature allows you to limitlessly enjoy your engaging audio!
